reason: A is the stronger proposal because it more clearly specifies the contact-pressure and environmental boundaries, distinguishes low-temperature strengthening from high-temperature tribo-oxidation, and explicitly acknowledges that transferring results from Al-containing BCC coatings to CoCrFeNi is uncertain.
